reason: I get home after 11pm and my bedtime moves every week, so a fade that counts from when I put the phone down instead of a clock time is exactly what my 30-minute timer gets wrong. The trial doesn't auto-charge, so I'd try it, and if day 14 actually shows I fall asleep faster I'd pay 4,900 monthly, not the yearly one, so I can cut it if it stops feeling worth it.
objection: I don't trust that a phone lying on the bed really knows when I fell asleep or woke up, and if the numbers are fuzzy the 'comparison' is just a sales screen. I'm also on iPhone, so 'we'll help you request a refund from Apple' isn't a real refund promise.
would_change_my_mind: If the 14-day report shows little or no difference between the two methods, I'd stay on the free version like the app itself says.
